caption:
Millennials are focused on buying homes, building savings and planning for retirement. Gen Z, on the other hand, is often more focused on short-term goals.

But what does this shift mean for the way younger Indians approach money, credit and long-term financial security?

The way we think about money today can shape our financial future tomorrow. 💰

#FinanceWithSharan #PersonalFinance #GenZ #FinancialPlanning #MoneyManagement FinancialLiteracy
